name: Starry Random Summon Dragonking
name_jp: 極星ランダム召喚・竜王
effects:
Quick ATB 1 to Summoners, Instant Cast, Master Mode, Instant ATB 1 & Starry Random Summon Bahamut to user
Master Mode: Zero SB Cost 1 & Instant SB/LB Cast
Starry Random Summon Bahamut: [Summoning Ability Damage +25%] or [Damage +5% & 50 SB Points] to party if user has/does not have Job Synergy
Interval Chase: [Single-target minor DeShell for 5 seconds, Summoning Ability Damage +30/35/40/45/50% to party] or [10 single-target Prismatic/NE summon magic attacks, 10% Stoneskin & Damage +10/15/20/25/30% to party] after 1/2/3/4/5 chases if user has/does not have Fate Synergy (max 5 chases)
Master Chase: Single-target Prismatic/NE summon magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Weakness Damage +30% for 1 turn to party, removes Master Mode
